_comment: Pin a ticker to a specific CIK, bypassing SEC's company_tickers.json.
Needed because a ticker's CIK is not stable over time: after a merger,
reincorporation, or holding-company reorganization, the ticker moves to a
NEW registrant while all the filing history stays under the predecessor.
company_tickers.json only ever reflects the current registrant.
Keys are tickers, values are CIKs as integers (unpadded). Keys starting
_XOM: ExxonMobil reorganized under a new holdco (CIK 2115436) in July 2026. That entity has no Form 4 history; 34088 is the operating predecessor. Remove this override once the new holdco accumulates its own insider filings.
